g.text: Codec, electret microphone and mono amplifier are implemented in this design; driver/electrical validation is pending. J504 AC-coupled output is not qualified for low-impedance headphones.

g.desc: Codec, electret microphone and mono amplifier are implemented in this design; driver/electrical validation is pending. J504 AC-coupled output is not qualified for low-impedance headphones.

g.text: TLV320AIC3104, pinout from the TI IBIS model. I2C 0x18. DVDD(32)=1.8V, IOVDD(7)=3.3V, AVDD(25)=3.3V, DRVDD(18/24)=3.3V. Unused analog inputs left open (see research note).

g.desc: TLV320AIC3104, pinout from the TI IBIS model. I2C 0x18. DVDD(32)=1.8V, IOVDD(7)=3.3V, AVDD(25)=3.3V, DRVDD(18/24)=3.3V. Unused analog inputs left open (see research note).

g.text: C323=22uF bulk and C328=2.2uF ceramic bypass are local to U803 VDD/GND; nominal values are not guaranteed effective capacitance.

g.desc: C323=22uF bulk and C328=2.2uF ceramic bypass are local to U803 VDD/GND; nominal values are not guaranteed effective capacitance.

g.text: Mic: electret biased from MICBIAS via R312 2.2k, AC-coupled by C325 into MIC1LP; MIC1LM is AC-coupled to GND by C326. Speaker: PAM8302A from LEFT_LOP through C321, /SD pulled up by R311, 2-pin speaker on J506.

g.desc: Mic: electret biased from MICBIAS via R312 2.2k, AC-coupled by C325 into MIC1LP; MIC1LM is AC-coupled to GND by C326. Speaker: PAM8302A from LEFT_LOP through C321, /SD pulled up by R311, 2-pin speaker on J506.
